units.source_text: [\[21\]](#part1331.html#w21) 唐诗人权德舆所作《玉团体》：

en.t: [21] The Tang poet Quan Deyu wrote in “Yutuan Ti”:
“Last night my skirt sash came undone; this morning a joy-spider flies.

units.source_text: 铅华不可弃，莫是藁砧归？”

en.t: I must not set aside my powder and rouge; perhaps my husband is coming home?”

units.source_text: 蟢子是蜘蛛之一种，藁砧是丈夫。

en.t: A xizi is a kind of spider, and gaozhen means one’s husband.

units.source_text: 《古今集》中亦有和歌云：“乐见今朝蟢子飞，

en.t: The Kokinshu also has a waka that says: “How happy I am to see the joy-spider flying this morning;
surely my beloved must have come to me in the night.”
